CREATOR TOOLS / LOCAL AI

Autopilot AI

Less friction between raw footage and a reviewed video draft.

Project overview

A local-first creator workspace using Next.js, FastAPI, SQLite and FFmpeg. V0.5 adds media preview, scene candidates, clip ranking and approved local MP4 assembly. Automatic YouTube uploads are not implemented.

Project JARVIS

A personal assistant, closer to home.

Project overview

I’m Sahil Rathod, a full stack developer who likes understanding how things work—and making them work better.

My projects move between web interfaces, creator tools, and experiments with local AI. I’m drawn to the whole journey: a rough idea, the system behind it, and the small details someone finally gets to use.
